name: UTF-8 BOM
description: Requires, allows, or forbids a leading UTF-8 BOM.
definition: Requires, as a `[warning]`, a leading UTF-8 BOM (`EF BB BF` / U+FEFF) to match `utf8_bom_mode`: `forbidden` flags a BOM, `required` flags a missing BOM, `allowed` never flags. Finding is at line 1. Automatically fixable: the fix strips or inserts the BOM.
